params.name: StartDate
params.description:
Start of the date range.
ISO-8601 Examples:
UTC datetime: 2022-03-18T21:52:26
UTC datetime with milliseconds: 2022-03-18T21:52:26.8816090Z
UTC date only: 2022-03-19
datetime with timezone: 2022-03-18T17:56:09.8683110-04:00

params.name: EndDate
params.description:
Must be equal to or later than StartDate.
ISO-8601 Examples:
UTC datetime: 2022-03-18T21:52:26
UTC datetime with milliseconds: 2022-03-18T21:52:26.8816090Z
UTC date only: 2022-03-19
datetime with timezone: 2022-03-18T17:56:09.8683110-04:00

params.name: DateReference
params.description:
Which date to filter on. Valid values: 
            
            CreatedOnDate, 
            InteractionDate

params.name: LastId
params.description: GUID of the last workflow from the previous page. Used for cursor-based pagination.

items.docs: Gets a list of Workflow objects in a given date range.
